- Extend the existing network device integration to add support for Juniper devices running Junos OS
- Git sync merge conflict messages will now show the respective connection names for the files
- Connections that are named as IPv4 addresses will now sort numerically when alphabetical sorting is enabled
- Add new buttons to force stop/kill in addition to the normal stop action for connection types that support them
- Update post migration dialog to emphasize that the new migrated vaults should not be opened in v23.9 and older to prevent corruption issues
- Fix various NullPointers
